AI Could Compromise Georgia's Secret Ballot, Experts Warn

Artificial intelligence could potentially compromise the secrecy of ballots in Georgia's voting system, according to cybersecurity experts. A flaw in the state's voting equipment could allow AI to match voters to their specific ballots, undermining the principle of a secret vote. Experts expressed embarrassment that such a vulnerability might still exist. The concern highlights potential risks to electoral integrity posed by advanced technology.
